summary: Round 3 with exact R(p) (ordered divisor pairs of 4p+1 with both factors = 3 mod 4), N<10^4 gives 2067 primes p=n^2+n+41 with p=1 mod 4 (max p ~ 10^8). Compared with 2067 residue-matched controls (same p mod 840 counts, drawn from all primes =1 mod 4 up to the same max): family mean R 7.38 vs control 8.73, median 4 vs 6, Mann-Whitney p = 7e-4. The Euler family has systematically lower R, and a plausible mechanism exists: 4p+1 = (2n+1)^2 + 164, so every prime divisor of 4p+1 must split in Q(sqrt(-41)) (since 164 = 4*41), which biases the divisor-residue statistic that R counts. Only one control draw was used.
